The error arose due to the Planner misinterpreting the verified information provided by WebSurfer. However, the Planner incorrectly referred to him as "Charles Louis Bretagne de La Trémoille," which was not supported by the sources cited. This misstep reflects a lack of attention to detail in reconciling the lineage described in the final validation step.
